name: hoeffding_lemma_scaled
stmt:
theorem hoeffding_lemma_scaled {α : Type*} [Fintype α] {X : α → ℝ} {c lam : ℝ}
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card α) (hc : 0 < c) (hzero : (∑ x : α, X x) = 0)
    (hb : ∀ x : α, |X x| ≤ c) :
    uniformExpectation (fun x => Real.exp (lam * X x)) ≤ Real.exp (lam ^ 2 * c ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
by
  have hczero : (∑ x : α, X x / c) = 0 := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_div, hzero]
    norm_num
  have hcb : ∀ x : α, |X x / c| ≤ 1 := by
    intro x
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hc]
    exact (div_le_one hc).mpr (hb x)
  have h := hoeffding_lemma (X := fun x => X x / c) (lam := lam * c) hN hczero hcb
  have harg : (fun x : α => Real.exp ((lam * c) * (X x / c)))
      = fun x : α => Real.exp (lam * X x) := by
    funext x
    congr 1
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hc]
    ring
  have h2 : (lam * c) ^ 2 / 2 = lam ^ 2 * c ^ 2 / 2 := by ring
  calc
    uniformExpectation (fun x => Real.exp (lam * X x))
        = uniformExpectation (fun x => Real.exp ((lam * c) * (X x / c))) := by rw [harg]
    _ ≤ Real.exp ((lam * c) ^ 2 / 2) := h
    _ = Real.exp (lam ^ 2 * c ^ 2 / 2) := by rw [h2]

name: azuma_diff_bound
stmt:
theorem azuma_diff_bound {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (n : ℕ)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card α) {d : Fin n → α → ℝ} {c : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ i, 0 < c i) (hd0 : ∀ i, (∑ a : α, d i a) = 0)
    (hdb : ∀ i a, |d i a| ≤ c i) (lam : ℝ) :
    uniformExpectation (fun w : Fin n → α => Real.exp (lam * ∑ i : Fin n, d i (w i))) ≤
      Real.exp (lam ^ 2 * (∑ i : Fin n, (c i) ^ 2) / 2)
proof:
by
  have hfunc : (fun w : Fin n → α => Real.exp (lam * (∑ i : Fin n, d i (w i))))
      = fun w : Fin n → α => ∏ i : Fin n, Real.exp (lam * d i (w i)) := by
    funext w
    calc
      Real.exp (lam * (∑ i : Fin n, d i (w i))) = Real.exp (∑ i : Fin n, lam * d i (w i)) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = ∏ i : Fin n, Real.exp (lam * d i (w i)) := Real.exp_sum _ _
  calc
    uniformExpectation (fun w : Fin n → α => Real.exp (lam * ∑ i : Fin n, d i (w i)))
        = (∏ i : Fin n, ∑ a : α, Real.exp (lam * d i a)) /
            ((Fintype.card α : ℝ) ^ n) := by
          unfold uniformExpectation
          rw [hfunc]
          rw [Fintype.card_pi_const, Nat.cast_pow]
          congr 1
          rw [Finset.prod_univ_sum (t := fun _ : Fin n => (Finset.univ : Finset α))
            (f := fun i a => Real.exp (lam * d i a))]
          simp
    _ = ∏ i : Fin n, uniformExpectation (fun a => Real.exp (lam * d i a)) := by
          unfold uniformExpectation
          calc
            (∏ i : Fin n, ∑ a : α, Real.exp (lam * d i a)) / ((Fintype.card α : ℝ) ^ n)
                = (∏ i : Fin n, ∑ a : α, Real.exp (lam * d i a)) /
                    (∏ i : Fin n, (Fintype.card α : ℝ)) := by
                  congr 1
                  rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
            _ = ∏ i : Fin n, ((∑ a : α, Real.exp (lam * d i a)) /
                    (Fintype.card α : ℝ)) := by
                  rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib]
    _ ≤ ∏ i : Fin n, Real.exp (lam ^ 2

name: azuma_tail
stmt:
theorem azuma_tail {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (n : ℕ)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card α) {d : Fin n → α → ℝ} {c : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ i, 0 < c i) (hd0 : ∀ i, (∑ a : α, d i a) = 0)
    (hdb : ∀ i a, |d i a| ≤ c i) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    (hS : 0 < ∑ i : Fin n, (c i) ^ 2) :
    uniformProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin n → α => t ≤ ∑ i : Fin n, d i (w i))) ≤
      Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / (2 * ∑ i : Fin n, (c i) ^ 2))
proof:
by
  let S : (Fin n → α) → ℝ := fun w => ∑ i : Fin n, d i (w i)
  let S2 : ℝ := ∑ i : Fin n, (c i) ^ 2
  let lam : ℝ := t / S2
  have hlam : 0 < lam := by
    dsimp [lam]
    exact div_pos ht hS
  have hmgf : uniformExpectation (fun w => Real.exp (lam * S w)) ≤
      Real.exp (lam ^ 2 * S2 / 2) := by
    simpa [S, S2] using azuma_diff_bound (n := n) hN hc hd0 hdb lam
  have hmarkov := markov_exp_tail (S := S) (t := t) (lam := lam) hlam
  have hexp : -lam * t + lam ^ 2 * S2 / 2 = -t ^ 2 / (2 * S2) := by
    dsimp [lam]
    field_simp
    ring
  calc
    uniformProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin n → α => t ≤ ∑ i : Fin n, d i (w i)))
        = uniformProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin n → α => t ≤ S w)) := by simp [S]
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-lam * t) * uniformExpectation (fun w => Real.exp (lam * S w)) := hmarkov
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-lam * t) * Real.exp (lam ^ 2 * S2 / 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmgf (Real.exp_nonneg _)
    _ = Real.exp (-lam * t + lam ^ 2 * S2 / 2) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]
    _ = Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / (2 * S2)) := by rw [hexp]
    _ = Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / (2 * ∑ i : Fin n, (c i) ^ 2)) := by rfl

name: azuma_tail_uniform
stmt:
theorem azuma_tail_uniform {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card α) {d : Fin n → α → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < c) (hd0 : ∀ i, (∑ a : α, d i a) = 0)
    (hdb : ∀ i a, |d i a| ≤ c) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    uniformProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin n → α => t ≤ ∑ i : Fin n, d i (w i))) ≤
      Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / (2 * (n : ℝ) * c ^ 2))
proof:
by
  have hnℝ : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn
  have hS : 0 < ∑ i : Fin n, (fun _ : Fin n => c) i ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_pos hnℝ (pow_pos hc 2)
  have h := azuma_tail (n := n) hN (d := d) (c := fun _ : Fin n => c)
    (fun _ => hc) hd0 hdb ht hS
  have hsum : (∑ i : Fin n, (fun _ : Fin n => c) i ^ 2) = (n : ℝ) * c ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [hsum] at h
  rw [show 2 * ((n : ℝ) * c ^ 2) = 2 * (n : ℝ) * c ^ 2 from by ring] at h
  exact h

name: azumaRademacher
doc: Rademacher 型 ±1 差（Fin 2 上的零均值有界函数）。
proof: fun a => if a = 0 then 1 else -1

name: azumaRademacher_sum_zero
stmt: lemma azumaRademacher_sum_zero : (∑ a : Fin 2, azumaRademacher a) = 0

name: azumaRademacher_abs_le_one
proof:
by
  intro a
  fin_cases a <;> norm_num [azumaRademacher]

name: azuma_examples
doc: 具体实例：Rademacher ±1、n = 2、t = 2 的 Azuma 尾界 e^{−1}。
stmt:
theorem azuma_examples :
    uniformProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin 2 → Fin 2 =>
        2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, azumaRademacher (w i))) ≤ Real.exp (-1)
proof:
by
  have h := azuma_tail_uniform (n := 2) (d := fun (_ : Fin 2) a => azumaRademacher a)
    (c := 1) (by norm_num : 0 < 2) (by norm_num : 0 < Fintype.card (Fin 2))
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) (fun _ => azumaRademacher_sum_zero)
    (fun _ a => azumaRademacher_abs_le_one a) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
  exact le_trans h (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by norm_num))

name: condExpFiber_eq_uniformExpectation
doc: **桥接**：非空纤维上，纤维均值条件期望 = 该纤维子类型上的 `uniformExpectation`。
stmt:
theorem condExpFiber_eq_uniformExpectation (π : α → β) (X : α → ℝ) (b : β)
    (h : (fiber π b).card ≠ 0) :
    condExpFiber π X b = uniformExpectation (fun a : {a // a ∈ fiber π b} => X a.1)
proof:
by
  classical
  have hcard : Fintype.card {a // a ∈ fiber π b} = (fiber π b).card := Fintype.card_coe _
  have hsum : (∑ a : {a // a ∈ fiber π b}, X a.1) = ∑ a in fiber π b, X a :=
    (Finset.sum_subtype (fiber π b) (fun x => Iff.rfl) X).symm
  rw [condExpFiber, if_neg h, uniformExpectation, hsum, hcard]

name: condExpFiber_hoeffding
doc:
**条件 Hoeffding（核心）**：鞅差（纤维均值零）+ `|d| ≤ c` + `c > 0` + 纤维非空
⟹ 每个纤维上的条件 MGF ≤ `exp(λ²c²/2)`。证明：桥接定理 + `hoeffding_lemma_scaled`。
stmt:
theorem condExpFiber_hoeffding (π : α → β) (d : α → ℝ) {c lam : ℝ}
    (hzero : CondZeroMean π d) (hc : 0 < c) (hb : ∀ a, |d a| ≤ c)
    (hne : ∀ b, (fiber π b).card ≠ 0) (b : β) :
    condExpFiber π (fun a => Real.exp (lam * d a)) b ≤ Real.exp (lam ^ 2 * c ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
by
  classical
  rw [condExpFiber_eq_uniformExpectation π _ b (hne b)]
  refine hoeffding_lemma_scaled (X := fun a : {a // a ∈ fiber π b} => d a.1) ?hN hc ?hzero' ?hb'
  · rw [Fintype.card_coe]
    exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (hne b)
  · rw [← Finset.sum_subtype (fiber π b) (fun x => Iff.rfl) d]
    exact hzero b
  · intro a
    exact hb a.1

name: FibreBound
doc:
**纤维一致上界**：`∀ b, E[Y | π](b) ≤ EB`（用 def 包装，避免同一陈述中
两种纤维索引类型的 `condExpFiber` 混用）。
stmt: def FibreBound (π : α → β) (Y : α → ℝ) (EB : ℝ) : Prop
proof: ∀ b, condExpFiber π Y b ≤ EB

name: fiberCard_sum_eq
doc: **纤维基数求和**：`∑_{b : g b = c} |细纤维 b| = |粗纤维 c|`。
stmt:
theorem fiberCard_sum_eq [Fintype β] (π : α → β) (g : β → γ) [DecidableEq γ] (c : γ) :
    ∑ b in (Finset.univ : Finset β).filter (fun b : β => g b = c), ((fiber π b).card : ℝ)
      = ((fiber (fun a => g (π a)) c).card : ℝ)
proof:
by
  have h1 := fiber_sum_eq_filtered_fiber_sum π g (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) c
  simpa [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul] using h1.symm

name: weightedCondExp_le_mul
doc: **加权聚合上界**：逐纤维 `E[Y|π] ≤ EB` ⟹ `weightedCondExp π g Y c ≤ |粗纤维 c|·EB`。
stmt:
theorem weightedCondExp_le_mul [Fintype β] (π : α → β) (g : β → γ) [DecidableEq γ]
    (Y : α → ℝ) {EB : ℝ} (c : γ) (h : ∀ b, condExpFiber π Y b ≤ EB) :
    weightedCondExp π g Y c ≤ ((fiber (fun a => g (π a)) c).card : ℝ) * EB
proof:
by
  unfold weightedCondExp
  calc ∑ b in (Finset.univ : Finset β).filter (fun b : β => g b = c),
        ((fiber π b).card : ℝ) * condExpFiber π Y b
      ≤ ∑ b in (Finset.univ : Finset β).filter (fun b : β => g b = c),
        ((fiber π b).card : ℝ) * EB :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h b) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    _ = (∑ b in (Finset.univ : Finset β).filter (fun b : β => g b = c),
        ((fiber π b).card : ℝ)) * EB := by rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = ((fiber (fun a => g (π a)) c).card : ℝ) * EB := by
        rw [fiberCard_sum_eq π g c]

name: tower_hoeffding_transfer
doc:
**塔性质串接（核心）**：条件 MGF 界从细滤链 `π` 提升到粗滤链 `g ∘ π`。
证明：`tower_property` 的两边夹 + 正基数消去。这是完整鞅版 Azuma 沿滤链
逐步复合的**单步**。
stmt:
theorem tower_hoeffding_transfer [Fintype β] (π : α → β) (g : β → γ) [DecidableEq γ]
    (Y : α → ℝ) {EB : ℝ} (hne : ∀ c : γ, (fiber (fun a => g (π a)) c).card ≠ 0)
    (hfin : FibreBound π Y EB) : FibreBound (fun a => g (π a)) Y EB
proof:
by
  intro c
  have htower := tower_property π g Y c
  have hle := weightedCondExp_le_mul π g Y c hfin
  have hcard : 0 < (fiber (fun a => g (π a)) c).card := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (hne c)
  have h1 : ((fiber (fun a => g (π a)) c).card : ℝ)
        * condExpFiber (fun a => g (π a)) Y c
      ≤ ((fiber (fun a => g (π a)) c).card : ℝ) * EB := by
    rw [htower]
    exact hle
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h1 (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hcard)

name: uniformExpectation_exp_le_of_condZeroMean
doc:
**无条件 MGF 界**：条件零均值 + 有界 ⟹ 全空间均匀期望满足
`E[e^{λd}] ≤ exp(λ²c²/2)`。证明：纤维分解 + 定理 2 + `∑_b |纤维 b| = N`。
stmt:
theorem uniformExpectation_exp_le_of_condZeroMean [Fintype β] (π : α → β) (d : α → ℝ)
    {c lam : ℝ}
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card α) (hzero : CondZeroMean π d) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hb : ∀ a, |d a| ≤ c) (hne : ∀ b, (fiber π b).card ≠ 0) :
    uniformExpectation (fun a => Real.exp (lam * d a)) ≤ Real.exp (lam ^ 2 * c ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
by
  have hsum_card : ∑ b, ((fiber π b).card : ℝ) = (Fintype.card α : ℝ) := by
    have h := fiber_sum_eq π (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ))
    simpa [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul] using h
  have hbound : ∑ b, ((fiber π b).card : ℝ)
        * condExpFiber π (fun a => Real.exp (lam * d a)) b
      ≤ ∑ b, ((fiber π b).card : ℝ) * Real.exp (lam ^ 2 * c ^ 2 / 2) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b _ =>
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (condExpFiber_hoeffding π d hzero hc hb hne b) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  calc uniformExpectation (fun a => Real.exp (lam * d a))
      = (∑ b, ((fiber π b).card : ℝ)
          * condExpFiber π (fun a => Real.exp (lam * d a)) b) / (Fintype.card α : ℝ) := by
        rw [uniformExpectation]
        congr 1
        rw [← fiber_sum_eq (π := π) (X := fun a => Real.exp (lam * d a))]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl
          (fun b _ => (card_mul_condExpFiber π (fun a => Real.exp (lam * d a)) b).symm)
    _ ≤ (∑ b, ((fiber π b).card : ℝ) * Real.exp (lam ^ 2 * c ^ 2 / 2))
          / (Fintype.card α : ℝ) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hbound (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = Real.exp (lam ^ 2 * c ^ 2 / 2) := by
        have hNne : (Fintype.card α : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hN)
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hsum_card]
        field_simp

name: azuma_tail_of_mgf
doc: **MGF 界 ⟹ 指数尾界**：取 `λ = t/σ²` 的切尔诺夫桥。
stmt:
theorem azuma_tail_of_mgf (S : α → ℝ) {σ2 t : ℝ} (hσ2 : 0 < σ2) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hmgf : uniformExpectation (fun w => Real.exp ((t / σ2) * S w))
      ≤ Real.exp ((t / σ2) ^ 2 * σ2 / 2)) :
    uniformProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => t ≤ S w)) ≤ Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / (2 * σ2))
proof:
by
  have hlam : 0 < t / σ2 := div_pos ht hσ2
  have hch := markov_exp_tail S (t := t) (lam := t / σ2) hlam
  have hstep : Real.exp (-(t / σ2) * t)
        * uniformExpectation (fun w => Real.exp ((t / σ2) * S w))
      ≤ Real.exp (-(t / σ2) * t) * Real.exp ((t / σ2) ^ 2 * σ2 / 2) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmgf (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hexp : Real.exp (-(t / σ2) * t) * Real.exp ((t / σ2) ^ 2 * σ2 / 2)
      = Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / (2 * σ2)) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    field_simp
    ring
  calc uniformProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => t ≤ S w))
      ≤ Real.exp (-(t / σ2) * t) * uniformExpectation (fun w => Real.exp ((t / σ2) * S w)) := hch
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-(t / σ2) * t) * Real.exp ((t / σ2) ^ 2 * σ2 / 2) := hstep
    _ = Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / (2 * σ2)) := hexp

name: azuma_tail_martingale
doc:
**鞅版 Azuma 尾界**：单个有界鞅差 + 条件零均值 ⟹
`P(d ≥ t) ≤ exp(−t²/(2c²))`（定理 7 + 8，取 `σ² = c²`）。
stmt:
theorem azuma_tail_martingale [Fintype β] (π : α → β) (d : α → ℝ) {c t : ℝ}
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card α) (hc : 0 < c) (ht : 0 < t) (hzero : CondZeroMean π d)
    (hb : ∀ a, |d a| ≤ c) (hne : ∀ b, (fiber π b).card ≠ 0) :
    uniformProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => t ≤ d w)) ≤ Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / (2 * c ^ 2))
proof:
by
  have hσ2 : 0 < c ^ 2 := pow_pos hc 2
  refine azuma_tail_of_mgf d hσ2 ht ?_
  exact uniformExpectation_exp_le_of_condZeroMean π d hN hzero hc hb hne

end Lattice
